name: Iori
message: 「Where'd she go？」
I had chased Ririmu all the way to the academy courtyard... but she was faster than I expected, and I lost sight of her.
Checking the time, it was already past 2 PM. It’s that time of day when students who finish early start enjoying their after-school hours.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, it's after school, so I guess it's fine for today.」
As for our conversation earlier, about ways for Ririmu to get stronger and so on, I'll talk to her about it in more detail tomorrow.
Looks like I received a message from someone.

name: Iori
message: 「What's this... 'Let's have a talk, I'm at the cafe on your left'」
The sender of the message was Kazamine Keisetsu.
She was the last of the Takamura Class students I hadn't met yet.
When I looked up, I saw the cafe sign standing to my left.
As I stepped inside, I found her sitting at a table in the back.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Nice to meet you, Muragaki Iori-san. I am Kazamine Keisetsu.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm surprised, you look just like Setsugekka...」
Keisetsu was the spitting image of Setsugekka.
When I saw her profile photo, I thought there might have been some mistake, but I never imagined they’d look this alike.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Fufu, I hear that often. Please, have a seat.」
At her words, I sat down across from her.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It seems you have already met Setsugekka.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I met her at the arena.」

name: Iori
message: 「She barged into Momiji and Victoria's match, went berserk, and collapsed, so she's in the infirmary now.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Oh my... that girl, doing that again... It's good to be eager, but there's a proper way to go about things, surely.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「And to go as far as to go berserk... Did she cause you any trouble？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, it's fine. There were no human casualties.」
...Though there was some property damage.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka can be a bit reckless and foolhardy at times.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I understand you will be in charge of guiding the Takamura Class from now on, and Setsugekka will likely be particularly difficult among them.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I'm sure she'll be a handful, but I ask for your kind support.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, yeah, of course. That's the plan.」
Unlike Setsugekka, Keisetsu seems intellectual and quite reasonable. It’s a little confusing when two people with the same face have such different personalities.

name: Iori
message: 「But how did you know I was a teacher for the Takamura Class？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「So, Sasaki-san hasn’t told you about me, then. Well, I suppose you’ll find out in due time.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「More importantly, I have a few things I’d like to ask you, Muragaki-san. May I？」

name: Iori
message: 「Sure, go ahead.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「How much do you know about our<d0030> Kazamine Family</d>？」

name: Iori
message: 「The Kazamine Family is one of the most influential warrior families in the Self-Defense Association. You’ve got strong ties to the financial world, making you one of the wealthiest families in the Association, neck and neck for the top spot.」

name: Iori
message: 「And you control the Kazamine Group, a multi-purpose conglomerate made up of several warrior families belonging to the Association, if I recall？」

The Muragaki family, my own lineage, also holds a seat at the tail end of the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association. So, I’m generally familiar with the warrior families that belong to the Association.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That is mostly correct, though the term ‘control’ is a bit misleading.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The leader of the Kazamine Group can be any candidate from a warrior family under the group’s umbrella, selected through a fair and impartial election.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The result just happens to be that the representative from the Kazamine Family is chosen by all. We would never dream of dominating or looking down on other families.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. I had the wrong idea. My apologies.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Not at all. I am glad you understand.」
Keisetsu said, taking a light sip of the black tea in her cup.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The Kazamine Family is one of the pillars supporting the Self-Defense Association’s finances. Without Kazamine’s investments, none of the Association’s operations could function.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「However, those in the Self-Defense Association do not seem to understand our importance.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Or rather, they understand it perfectly well, but because they cling to outdated, pre-Meiji Restoration ideals, they refuse to acknowledge it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, the warrior types aren't exactly fond of talking about money.」

Samurai don't concern themselves with counting coins; a warrior may starve, but he’ll still hold his toothpick with dignity. That’s why many in the Association look down on the Kazamine Family, the ones handling the books.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Do you feel the same, Muragaki-san？」

name: Iori
message: 「Not at all. I know all too well how important money is.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That’s good. My judgment was not wrong, then.」
...Huh？ What’s that supposed to mean？

name: Keisetsu
message: 「In this day and age, slighting the economy is nothing short of anachronistic.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The Kazamine family is growing impatient with the members of the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association, who remain tethered to tradition and custom, resisting any change in their mindset.」

name: Iori
message: 「O-oh, I see.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Changing this situation—that is the collective will of our family, the Kazamines.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If their mindset undergoes reform, the Kazamine family will no longer be treated as having an unjustly low status within the Self-Defense Association.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Through this, both the Kazamine family and the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association can hope for even greater success. We believe this reform is necessary to prepare for the future.」

name: Iori
message: 「W-wait a second！ Can I ask you something？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, please go ahead.」

name: Iori
message: 「You've been speaking on behalf of the Kazamine family's collective will this whole time, but who exactly are you in the family？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「My apologies. I should have introduced myself first.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I, Kazamine Keisetsu, am a candidate for the next head of the Kazamine family.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「In time, I intend to become the head of the Kazamine family and the leader of the Kazamine Group.」

name: Iori
message: 「A candidate for the next head...？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「In the Kazamine family, we place more value on individual ability than on bloodline.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The most capable person among the clan becomes the head—this is a tradition the Kazamine family has upheld for generations.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That is precisely why the Kazamine family has amassed such immense wealth.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「We are distinct from the likes of the Suzakuin family, who treat bloodline as absolute and remain bound by antiquated customs.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I am currently managing many projects, including the franchise business for martial arts dojos, the operation of Jindou shops, and Tamahagane research laboratories.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The businesses are all generally going well. In recognition of those achievements, I was recommended as a candidate for the family head at age fourteen.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The current head of the Kazamine family and I share no blood relation.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「However, by demonstrating my own abilities, I have been recognized as a candidate for the next head.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Those who demonstrate superior ability lead the clan. This is what it means to be a Kazamine, and this is our strength.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「This Murakumo Academy is currently in the hands of the Suzakuin family.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「We of the Kazamine family are not amused by the current situation where Suzakuin Momiji receives special treatment and is being touted as a star.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That is why Setsugekka and I have come to this academy.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka has a mission to defeat Suzakuin Momiji.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「When a Kazamine defeats Suzakuin, the face of the academy, those antiquated conventions will lose their dominance.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「They will have it painfully driven home to them that what they clung to had neither basis nor value.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「With Suzakuin's defeat as the catalyst, the Self-Defense Association will change.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「This is one of the plans to realize the future Kazamine aims for, and one of the straightforward reasons why Setsugekka and I are at this academy.」
I see. That makes everything clear.
This girl takes pride in being a Kazamine and already possesses the mettle of a family head.
She is, beyond a shadow of a doubt, a spokesperson for the interests the Kazamine Family seeks.

name: Iori
message: 「...So, what's the point of telling me all this？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It's merely a self-introduction, Muragaki Iori-san.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What kind of person I am, and what I have in mind. Wouldn't it be easier to accept knowing that rather than being left in the dark？」
Well, that much is true.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「At this academy, I'm treated as a special-status student. Therefore, I basically won't be attending classes.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Since I'm in the Quartermaster Division, there shouldn't be anything I need to learn from you directly anyway.」
I can follow her reasoning... but I still can't accept it.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「As I mentioned earlier, I'm involved in managing multiple business operations.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Normally I give instructions remotely, though depending on the situation, I may need to go on-site in person.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「All of this was approved as a special exception when I enrolled.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「So please pay me no mind. I would be delighted if you could focus closely on instructing Setsugekka.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That is everything I wished to ask you, as well as everything I had to tell you for now.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Do you have any questions？」

name: Iori
message: 「...No, nothing in particular.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「In that case, I have work to attend to, so I'll take my leave now.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I look forward to working with you going forward, Muragaki-san.」
With a light bow, Keisetsu walked away.
